mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO attachments (original_name, storage_name, url, file_type, file_extension, file_size, mime_type, source, biz_id, tags, remark, user_id, storage_path) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{storageName}, #{url}, #{fileType}, #{fileExtension}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{source}, #{bizId}, #{tags}, #{remark}, #{userId}, #{storagePath})
SELECT last_insert_rowid()
mapper.update: UPDATE attachments SET tags = #{tags}, remark = #{remark}, source = #{source}, biz_id = #{bizId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments WHERE storage_path = #{storagePath}
